name: Bifida ferment lysate
description: Bifida Ferment Lysate (CAS 96507-89-0 ), also sourced and referenced as Bifidobacterium longum lysate, is a postbiotic ingredient derived from the fermentation and controlled lysis of Bifidobacterium cultures. It delivers a complex of proteins, polysaccharides, and metabolic byproducts that support skin barrier function and moisture retention in finished formulations. In prestige and mass-market skincare, it is formulated into serums and moisturizers. The ingredient is frequently used in essence products targeting barrier repair and environmental stress defense. Pharmaceutical topical preparations use it as a bioactive humectant to support compromised or sensitive skin conditions. In anti-aging product lines, it is incorporated alongside peptides and antioxidants to reinforce the skin's natural defense mechanisms against oxidative damage. This helps maintain a youthful appearance and skin resilience. Biotechnology research applications also source it as a reference material for microbiome-related skin studies and efficacy testing. This ensures that the ingredient meets modern scientific standards for topical application. Bifida Ferment Lysate is supplied primarily as a liquid or aqueous solution, with concentration levels varying by manufacturer specification. It is available in cosmetic-grade quality for global distribution. Documentation typically includes safety assessments and microbiological testing suitable for personal care compliance. Bulk supply is offered in drums or smaller packaging formats to accommodate various production scales. These options allow both large-scale formulators and development-stage buyers to access the material efficiently.
